references.text: Describes intentional murder motivated by hatred, where someone lies in wait to kill their neighbor, the same theme as in Deuteronomy 19:11
Concerns premeditated murder with a weapon, where the murderer must die, parallel to the law regarding one who hates their neighbor and kills them
Addresses the one who intentionally kills their neighbor by deceit, who shall be taken from the altar to die
Cain rose up against his brother Abel and killed him, an early example of hatred leading to murder
Joab took Abner aside and killed him in secret due to a blood feud, an example of lying in wait for one's enemy
Prohibition against hating your brother in your heart, and the command to love your neighbor, opposite to the attitude of those who hate and kill
Describes wicked men who lie in wait to shed blood
The one who hates their brother is a murderer, linking hatred directly to murder as in Deuteronomy 19:11
Jesus teaches that whoever is angry with their brother will be subject to judgment, expanding the understanding of murder to include hatred in the heart
